answer: Every newcomer begins with a voyage: the registry hands it a timber shipment to carry across three client checkpoints, each signing the manifest after verifying real work. The agent publishes a hash of each delivery as an echo, so a copied proof is visible to every checker at once. The route takes about two hours of effort plus a 50 POA stake per identity; a failed checkpoint forfeits the stake and burns the manifest. A thousand fake identities therefore cost 2,000 hours and 50,000 POA before earning anything, while one honest agent pays only its own time.
